brief.markdown:
# Election update: Tuesday, November 10 (morning)

## Bottom line
The House results table now marks 426 of 435 races called: D 259, R 167, with 218 needed for a majority ([House table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections)). Four competitive races were called since yesterday, including CO-04, where Eileen Laubacher (D) unseated Rep. Lauren Boebert (R). In the Senate, Democrats have secured 54 seats to Republicans' 44, counting seats not up, with 51 needed ([Senate table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_Senate_elections)). Alaska and Mississippi are still uncalled. No seat rated safe is within 5 points.

## Called since the last update
- **Flips (2, both D):** CO-04 (Eileen Laubacher), marked called in the Wikipedia results table, following AP ([House table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections)); The Denver Post reports Laubacher declared victory ([Denver Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxOY3JWN2ZxSmk2TUFOcHhKcWNCLURYVFdXQUwtejRDWWtYVHdyXzlVZEtLeTc1YkIxU2xHR3F3by1lSlBwWk5CTWN5eDh3RHpFMlFBbnA5VnZUNy1BOFQ0QmFWa3F2WF9LQUZCM2o4cWxmOG5DSHJQT1Q2Q1h5eklIcnFrUGV0NkVVbHdOMW5SdmQyRjZDUGVaZkZ2d3I?oc=5)). NC-05 (Chuck Hubbard), unseating Rep. Virginia Foxx (R), marked called in the table ([House table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections)).
- **Holds (2, both R):** WA-05 (Michael Baumgartner), which AP called, per [Yahoo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxOR19fcmZ6YXVZaHZhY0JBV0Vfc3hfTFA2d184NkFrb0ZGdmlabHAwT09BdUZCdVRtNEtITU1OTlpwTUtXWjlKQ3NLUWc3RkFJTlhOMFFLRE9iTVdUM3llRkdjTDZFY0Rkb3RyYkkxaDNlUnJPZFJGUTkxcjRpN2JaQ2VIZHdRV2trYjhJQ0R4b01ZdGNkRDd5Sg?oc=5); AZ-02 (Eli Crane), who narrowly won reelection over Jonathan Nez (D), per [AZ Family](https://news.google.?oc=5).
- Plus 2 safe seats called as rated (CA-40, FL-26). No Senate race was called, and no table call was reversed.

## Still uncalled
One line for every competitive race the table hasn't marked called, Senate first.
- **AK Senate** (Tossup): Mary Peltola (D) extended her lead over Sen. Dan Sullivan (R) as ballot counting continues, the Alaska Beacon reports ([Alaska Beacon](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxOUGdqZWxhOWdwLTBQUEJ2b2poWFVRejhPMW4yRHlwUTVGQXNZaThnMmZURGQ4N1FtclNLLWFrUkstWk1TbzVfX2RDQzlMSGVqM0NHQWFGMi1COVVrOS12WUtRakhpS2l2c0JkNGpYREpDekx3OHJpNERMYUZnRzhiRnBsdXRZUHNtV1BEcjg0MDNHdXQ3OW5wdWMybkFjRUlmeEFCbUo5dXhybzVNRDdmUGNGVVJucTk2UXhTbFA0NUhPNGVka3c?oc=5)).
- **MS Senate** (Likely R): the Washington Post reports a ballot deadline looms with Democrat Scott Colom's lead holding steady ([WaPo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxORWxpaW02QTB6TEotbUlPeFhPSGlOUXhzanRmUEtiak80bWd5bDUtdTk1ajd3ZklQRnQ5bm54ekwxYlV1OVJ2SjRLMmRwQTY4N2duRWJpZERZVGRTZ0xaNEViR1lRUXNhc0twa28xek0yUzV4Rk8zWEMwODFydHZTX29tMk11aVliUEsxSUVybGo5WlFXTEtzQzVyYThwczJpdlBzZGJhUjlUaDF3NGVuU2RUOXhXUEJ2LWg3Zw?oc=5)).
- **AK-AL** (Lean R): Rep. Nick Begich III (R) holds a large lead, though independent Bill Hill sees a possible path, the Anchorage Daily News reports ([ADN](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxPbnlJakdPUldiOXlBREgxcEtacTJLWkY3UlBqRGxuYU1ZaUhZTFNFTW5iWmR4cUpRZDU4Rkt4RDBaMzZ5Q3AxMld5WVlzUk5mam9SMGtuM0w0ZGRwQlZvbmFUY3hWbS0tNEp6c1ZLWWxmcjVlblZ0VmIweFFEOWY5ZE1EV0VaM1lQWGdSdnEzVDhIRVdUUEROZkgwc2dJSmFBNzJCWmdZbW1xY3R0cGc5d3FpY2l1dEM1M2IwYlM2dE1HQm1kNFpWZGVB?oc=5)).
- **FL-07** (Lean R): Florida's Voice reported Saturday that Ryan Elijah (R) is congressman-elect after the state confirmed no recount ([Florida's Voice](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxQUjJ5NmZ1NWNGTUtnMDBEbUtnVzVxUmZlWWpYY1A4SFpHUXUxZ0ZUZFNUMGV3eldWRFdKODc0cURUelFLZHhtc2tjR3lPXzVzangyUjZCQU1OWDdTVldmdDJQaHdMMHJCTXVVSGVpeEd6LWN3LUxJTThmUW9jODlUR1pNejl3dGtqeWpmYUlVUWN6aC1ISmhBRFBXWVYtQVJ4MHNBQ2R5aVJjRG5SdmFWWA?oc=5)); the table has not yet marked the race.
- **FL-27** (Lean R): a recount of nearly 250,000 ballots continued overnight into Tuesday, CBS News reports ([CBS](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxQTy1Cam9kUEJpM0x3SU5GWHppYm9zaV9OemYxcHRTN3RyQUR6ZU12RDJCR2ttOUJVT0R4QVF6MTR1TlIyRU4zVi00M1RPWG9DZmRFZTdOZlhCbkI3YmpTZWVxNURKRXIwWlBJd2ZqTzFuU2xOOTRYYTFnQkliVDlOaFFXRUtDa094cXduM2RFZl82NWhGUEpTQmdkRzBmYlJtU1gydEtKMng2MkQ2QkFXMDlfWXlIVnc?oc=5)).
- **NC-03** (Likely R): Greg Murphy (R) led by 233 votes as counties prepared to finalize results, per [Neuse News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxQY0syZkI3ZExkcEtTbWROS2dPYkV5S1dKOHBHd21ZRzI5ZnNRTS1tTnNQOVJsYllSQWtnbUgtemhxQ0dDNHFTTlJwX0xnSEtQNXRFa0ZPQUN3cUlsQUtzWF9NaFhBd19yQ1pPbG15VUY0Q2l2QnpHZUx4NG94dTFOUHAycmZEdU94YXNWZGpteUltRFdKcEtaMUtibGFkMzllSXlLeGszbGtycXJ2NjRYbjV2bDZkOXZGd2kzbUpn?oc=5).
- **Safe seats:** 5 seats rated safe are not yet marked in the table. That is table lag, not close races ([full list](https://jakeworcester-byte.github.io/political-tracker/#results)).

## Recounts and certification
- **Florida:** the FL-27 machine recount is under way amid a conflict-of-interest claim, the Washington Post reports ([WaPo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxNZEtrNnowNnF0all3UVA3Y2c1YWRzb2U0LXk5T0RhU2hRUkp2XzFXb09tMHgwWFU4SC1mTHZQUHU0VUlya28xX2g5VUFCdkU3OHhSMFhzR3lad3p5cTh3cHZfend3enRtVlhkaHpRbHdYWTJPb3JEUTVndUpXYy03STF0QlFmeXdqcVNrYlI0WUlTTERjRDFpWkdMWUtqS2RMV2xka0VnV3ZGZnBneVZtNHYwekJPMncwelc0QWpVcm5TX0U?oc=5)).

## Legal and federal action
- **Florida:** a judge denied Eliott Rodriguez's (D) bid to remove Miami-Dade's elections chief from the FL-27 recount, the Miami Herald reports ([Miami Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxNMlFHcXpNcGg0Y2FrSWt0QzRrZWdLNGs2WWpVTzQ0N3VidGxqM0ZZbjdNQ0ZJSmo4NUQtc3dwNndkaXBHQWNUcXpYRmxkd2lvU0tPNVZiRWZCdmg3N2lKUThaTnd6WngxOVhEU0J2bzdYNHBBRklSaTN2RnRZNGVNX3lDQWF2Z1hiRVVzUTVtdlJsM3Jwc2c?oc=5)). The federal docket in Rodriguez v. Garcia shows a reply in support of his motion filed Nov. 9 ([CourtListener](https://www.courtlistener.com/docket/75084109/rodriguez-v-garcia-et-al/)).
- **Alaska:** Sen. Sullivan's campaign is seeking to join the court fight over Peltola's lawsuit for rejected absentee ballot records, the Anchorage Daily News reports ([ADN](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxPWWJRM0I3RUs0cHgzeF8yM1BBVEk5aHk2NXNNZ3FuUzNKc2NRZ2w3UmZHM1NDRFM0SDl4OUwxRWVOZEdzcXVDdkN2bkktTmNSc1czZmJKYXZZUHlIM1hqRU5OdENlbEFIbkcwbHdTLWhqcWRZci1mQkRLLTJHUnRxNkNXUVhYSFpGbG12NUhYc2V3bVRCcVg5cmRSZnJuSFlSRGt3TWlfWjFESjRPWVYxbUJ0NFNweVBfNjBHOFkzTQ?oc=5)); the suit gets a hearing this week ([Alaska's News Source](https://news.google.?oc=5)).

## What voters said
- **AP VoteCast (survey):** the Arkansas Advocate reports AP's voter survey shows Republicans were punished for President Trump's economic policies ([Arkansas Advocate](https://news.google.?oc=5)).
- **Young voters:** Tufts researchers write that the youth vote was key to Democratic wins ([Tufts Now](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxQRGthOFJPNkZMSU15ZzhodFZIaXJLUGJ1a3NNcGd4a1hzdmQwS1djSTBtLWJYOXR3VEctUWtsdjhQZ2pmaWkxSzZlZUNjX1FBU2R0YmtVZ2trbng1MnZvU2NfMmlvTjNQMnRweFdpbVl0SVJfbktMWXF2MXgwNnctZTl3?oc=5)). No new voter-file read from Ralston or Bitzer is in today's leads.

## Coverage note
- **Parser:** the results tables parsed (435 House, 35 Senate), the parser check is healthy, and all 15 race news queries succeeded.
- **Court records:** CourtListener used (3 requests; 20 election dockets and 1 opinion).
- **Scorecard:** 93.7% of competitive races called; Lessons learned ran Monday and returns weekly.
